patch_description: Structural redesign from a flat function chain into a composable stage-object pipeline (PredictFusePipeline) where each stage owns its parameters and reports a noise-scale contract to the next stage. Key architectural changes: (1) a shared SignalContext carries the raw signal, denoised signal, and noise sigma so every stage is calibrated against the same robust noise estimate instead of re-estimating; (2) the bidirectional Kalman is rewritten as a forward filter + backward RTS-style smoother information fusion (single sweep per direction, covariance-aware 50/50 blend) which lowers lag error; (3) noise-dominated wavelet scales are fully hard-killed (no residual pass) while a new per-scale SURE-style criterion decides signal-bearing scales, directly attacking the weakest metric (noise_reduction 0.37) without touching correlation-bearing scales; (4) a new final DirectionalHysteresis stage with sign-consistency smoothing over a 3-tap slope vote reduces slope_changes and false_reversals; (5) the predictive edge-polynomial stage now blends a center-evaluated and edge-evaluated quadratic in a noise-adaptive ratio (more lead when SNR is high), improving responsiveness. Output contract (len = n - W + 1, same API) preserved exactly.
